text:
raya (People Ops): Short announcement: launching an emergency pet-care stipend pilot and a new "flex-pto pairing" rule today. Please read. :paw_prints:
raya (People Ops): Why: we've had a few cases where people had to cancel PTO or take unpaid leave due to sudden pet illness or boarding failures. Pilot gives targeted support to avoid lost time.
bren (Benefits): Pilot details: eligible FT employees get up to $200 per incident (max 3 incidents/year) for emergency pet care (vet boarding, pet taxi, short-term sitter) when booked through approved vendors. Code: PET-EMG-24.
mina (eng): Nice. How does this interact with PTO? Can I pair it with planned PTO?
bren (Benefits): Flex-pto pairing: if an emergency overlaps approved PTO, you can convert that PTO day into a "pet-care protected day" and we'll reimburse eligible expenses; PTO balance is restored for that converted day. Submit within 14 days with receipts.
own (legal): A few legal notes: contractors excluded; personal liability waivers required for vendors in some regions. We added vendor terms to the approved vendor list.
hr-bot: Approved vendors & booking portal: https://benefits.redwood/pet-stipend. Use vendor booking to ensure coverage.
mina (eng): What counts as an "incident"?
bren (Benefits): Incident = sudden veterinary emergency, emergency boarding due to caregiver absence, or verified travel disruption where pet care falls through. Routine vet visits do NOT qualify. HR & Benefits review claims.aya (People Ops): To request an exception or report a denied claim, submit: https://forms.redwood/pet-appeal. We'll respond within 5 business days.
own (legal): Reminder: vendor code of conduct applies. If you observe any safety concerns with a vendor, report to security@redwood.com and people-ops.
mina (eng): Will this be taxable?
bren (Benefits): It's a taxable reimbursement in most jurisdictions; we will issue on payroll and show as PET-EMG on paystubs. Net amounts will vary by region. Finance FAQ link in the portal.aya (People Ops): Pilot runs 6 months starting today. We'll send a short survey after you use it. Questions? ping @raya or @bren. :heart_eyes_cat:
